requirement: Users of the documented Activiti example environment shall be able to authenticate through Keycloak. Access to protected platform functions shall require a valid Keycloak token, and invalid, expired, or invalidated tokens shall be rejected.

Authenticated users shall be able to view process definitions deployed in the Example Runtime Bundle and start a new SimpleProcess instance. The developer guide shall document a complete example combining process execution and human task handling, with a human participant and a reference to the corresponding example module.

Users shall be able to inspect audit events associated with a newly started process instance through the Audit Service and obtain process execution information through the Query Service where that service is available.

Task operations in the documented example environment shall be restricted to logged-in users with the ACTIVITI_USER role, represented by the ROLE_ACTIVITI_USER authority. The Spring Boot application shall use Spring Security to maintain the user, group, and role information used for authorization.
The Kubernetes/GKE example deployment shall make selected internal services accessible from outside the cluster through NGINX ingress and a public IP address.
Operators shall be able to configure the example deployment's data input rate and cloud component replica counts through deployment descriptors to conduct scalability experiments.
